<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

In a finite coupled domain, pointwise coverage of demand with still-working old support yields a mass floor under one positive total weight; preservation for all natural weights characterizes inclusion.

Canonical source: [ChanceFloors.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ChanceFloors.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Finite event enumeration, natural event weights, target demand AND oldWorks, and Fulfilled; probability interpretation requires positive total weight.

Coupling, time window, coverage and validity of the undertaking need evidence; weights are not ethical importance.
